scope: Expanded infantry attacks against passive vehicles
review_fixes: Squads dismount together on land and retain the transport position.
Repeated placement pays placement and reload once.
Crew injuries use shared body weights and vital-hitpoint lethality.
Native capture restarts virtual recovery windows.
Sea visibility uses AGL-to-ASL conversion; infantry retains map-range policy.
Native grenade samples explicitly arm the fuse.
Cached magazine-to-muzzle lookup avoids repeated utility-muzzle scans.
note: Each affected behavior is covered by its final dedicated suite. Earlier broad suites retain their source-match lists so later changes to unrelated vehicle code are explicit. Failed exploratory runs and concurrent packaging failures are excluded. Some temporary mission-source copies have been removed by environment cleanup; their retained RPT hashes and passing completion records remain available. A null source-match value means the copy is unavailable.
